tanenbaum.title: Computer Networks
tanenbaum.authors: Andrew S. Tanenbaum and David J. Wetherall

data-communication-fundamentals.why: The five components, data flow modes and network criteria the papers ask about.

transmission-media.read: Chapter 7: Transmission Media; Chapter 3: Introduction to Physical Layer (transmission impairment)
transmission-media.why: Guided and unguided media, fibre propagation modes, and attenuation, distortion and noise.

networks-and-internetworking.read: Chapter 1: Introduction (network types and physical topologies)
networks-and-internetworking.why: LAN, MAN, WAN and the bus, ring, star and mesh topologies.

osi-and-tcp-ip-models.read: Chapter 2: Network Models; Chapter 10: Error Detection and Correction
osi-and-tcp-ip-models.why: The OSI and TCP/IP layers, parity and CRC.
OSI compared with TCP/IP, as the 2021/22 paper asks.

switching.why: Circuit switching, datagram networks and virtual-circuit setup with VCIs.

routing.why: Distance-vector and link-state routing with Dijkstra's algorithm.

network-layer-protocols-and-ip-addressin.read: Chapters 18 and 19: Introduction to Network Layer; Network-Layer Protocols
network-layer-protocols-and-ip-addressin.why: IPv4 addressing, the datagram and fragmentation, ARP, ICMP and IGMP.
